assertions.description: <menuitem> parses as a dedicated element rather than HTMLUnknownElement.
HTMLMenuItemElement is exposed on the global (RuntimeEnabled=MenuElements in the Chromium IDL).
HTMLMenuBarElement is exposed on the global.
menuitem exposes the disabled IDL attribute from HTMLMenuItemElement.
menuitem exposes checked and defaultChecked IDL attributes for live and default checked state.
A disabled menuitem actually matches the :disabled pseudo-class (soft-disabled semantics from the explainer).
menuitem carries the CommandInvokerElement mixin (commandForElement) declared in the Chromium IDL.

An installed screen reader or the accessibility tree reports role menubar/menu/menuitem for the new elements without author ARIA; requires an accessibility-tree inspection on a MenuElements-enabled build.
assertions.test: Inspect the accessibility tree of a <menubar><menulist><menuitem> structure on a Chrome 143+ build with --enable-blink-features=MenuElements; the computed roles must be menubar/menu/menuitem with no aria-* attributes present.
